is call may still observe the row. The request body must be empty.\n- [Update a saved server](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-referenc
e/servers/update-a-saved-server.md): Sparse update: omitted fields are unchanged. Renaming re-checks per-workspace uniqueness (`40
9` on a clash). Editing a server shared as an OAuth connection requires project admin. `clientSecret` and `clearClientSecret` are
mutually exclusive.\n- [List a project's server groups](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/list-a-projects-server-
groups.md): A server group is an immutable snapshot of a set of saved servers. Pinning one on an environment is what keeps a run o
ff its host's live server list, so a composed run keeps testing the servers it was composed against even after the shared host is
edited.\n- [Snapshot servers into a server group](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/snapshot-servers-into-a-serve
r-group.md): Creates a server group holding exactly the given servers and responds `201` with its detail. Groups are create-only:
there is no update route, because an editable group would reintroduce the drift that pinning exists to prevent. Names are unique p
er project, so a clash responds `409`. Servers must b…\n- [List a project's environments](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/en
vironments/list-a-projects-environments.md): The project environments saved in the project. Archived environments are excluded unl
ess `includeArchived=true`: you need that to find one to restore.\n- [Check what this deployment's environment surface supports](h
ttps://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/check-what-this-deployments-environment-surface-supports.md): Report which envir
onment features this MCPJam deployment accepts. Call it before sending a model override: clients ship independently of the platfor
m, and a field an older deployment does not know is a hard validation error there rather than a silently ignored one. A deployment
too old to answer rep…\n- [Show one environment](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/show-one-environment.md): Rea
d one environment, including the `revision` you pass back as `expectedRevision` when writing to it.\n- [Preview what an environmen
t resolves to](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/preview-what-an-environment-resolves-to.md): Resolve an environm
ent to the exact execution inputs a run would use right now: the host's current config and the closed server set. Returns 409 when
the environment cannot currently produce a runnable configuration; `details.code` carries the specific reason (`ENV_NO_SERVERS`,
`ENV_HOST_MISSING`, ……\n- [Get or create an unnamed environment for a composed stack](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/enviro
nments/get-or-create-an-unnamed-environment-for-a-composed-stack.md): GET-OR-CREATE an UNNAMED, content-addressed environment for
a composed stack: a host plus an optional server group and model override. The environment does not appear in the project's list o
f named environments.\n- [Archive an environment](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/archive-an-environment.md): A
rchive an environment. It stops being selectable for runs and frees its name for a new one, but the row is kept and can be restore
d: this is why archive is a sub-action rather than a DELETE. Requires `expectedRevision`: the revision you last read. If the envir
onment changed since, the write is reje…\n- [List a project's scenarios](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/list-a-proj
ects-scenarios.md): The studies published from this project: name, access mode, attached servers, and share link. Read-only.\n- [P
ublish an environment for user testing](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/publish-an-environment-for-user-testing.md):
PUT, not POST, because publishing is IDEMPOTENT: one study per environment, and publishing an already-published environment retur
ns the existing one rather than minting a second. `created` says which happened.\n- [Unpublish an environment](https://docs.mcpjam
.com/api-reference/studies/unpublish-an-environment.md): Takes the study down. Unpublishing does not require User Testing access,
so an organization that loses access can still take a live study down.\n- [Get a study](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/stud
ies/get-a-study.md): One study's full read: execution settings (model, system prompt, tool-approval policy, attached servers, shar
e link), the environment it publishes, and the insights envelope over its latest analyzed window.\n- [Update a scenario](https://d
ocs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/update-a-scenario.md): Change a study's identity or its exposure, but not both in one call. *
*Send `mode` on its own.** Identity and exposure are separate operations upstream, and applying them in sequence could leave the s
tudy live in a mode you did not ask for.\n- [List a scenario's sessions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/list-a-scen
arios-sessions.md): What visitors did, as summaries. Project members only: this route is deliberately absent from the guest allowl
ist, so a share-link visitor can never read other visitors' sessions.\n- [Get a session transcript](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-re
ference/studies/get-a-session-transcript.md): The projected transcript, paged. Tool payloads and blobs are dropped, and the stored
blob URL is never returned.\n- [Set the guest-execution caps](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/set-the-guest-executi
on-caps.md): The spend dial for anonymous visitors. A FULL REPLACEMENT. Send every field. These caps only mean something as a set,
and a partial update that raised one while leaving another stale would produce a combination nobody chose.\n- [Rotate the share l
ink](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/rotate-the-share-link.md): Mints a new share link and stops the old URL from gr
anting access. Everyone you shared it with needs the new one.\n- [Invite a member](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/i
nvite-a-member.md): Upsert by email, so re-inviting somebody is not an error. Only meaningful while `mode` is `invited_only`.\n- [
Remove a member](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/remove-a-member.md): Removal NARROWS access, so it bumps `accessVer
sion` and cuts off any session that member already had: it takes effect at once rather than at expiry.\n- [Point a scenario at a d
ifferent environment](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/point-a-scenario-at-a-different-environment.md): Keeps the stu
dy's LINK, its members and its session history while changing what visitors actually reach. The alternative, unpublish and republi
sh, mints a new link, which means re-sharing it with everyone.\n- [Session metrics](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/
session-metrics.md): Volumes, completion and feedback rates over the study's sessions.\n- [Usage breakdown](https://docs.mcpjam.co
m/api-reference/studies/usage-breakdown.md): Which models, tools and servers the study's sessions used.\n- [Current window signals
](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/current-window-signals.md): What the miner extracted from the current window, and
where you get the window id the insights read takes.\n- [List scenario findings](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/lis
t-scenario-findings.md): Every finding raised over this study's windows, dismissed ones included: dismissal is a state on the find
ing, not a deletion.\n- [Read a window's insights](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/read-a-windows-insights.md): Poll
this after requesting a generation.\n- [Request insights for the current window](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/re
quest-insights-for-the-current-window.md): **No credits are consumed**: the model cost is on MCPJam. Runs a model over the study's
current window and draws on the organization's `insightsPerDay` ledger, which counts REQUESTS and is SHARED with eval-run and swa
rm run insights, so a request here takes one from there.\n- [Cancel a window's generation](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/s
tudies/cancel-a-windows-generation.md): Releases a generation that is stuck `pending`. Idempotent against an already-finished one.
\n- [Dismiss a finding](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/dismiss-a-finding.md): Keyed on the finding's stable remedia
